description: Download one Canvas file and save it to local disk. Returns the saved path and size. Get file_id from list_course_files or list_my_files.

dest_dir.description: Folder to save into: the server's download folder (CANVAS_DOWNLOAD_DIR) or a folder inside it, such as "week1". Anywhere else is refused. Leave it out to use the download folder itself.

file_id.description: File ID (numeric string). Get it from list_course_files, list_my_files or list_group_files.

name: download_file
title: Download File
